reasons.requirements: The spec and the diff cover all seven acceptance criteria, including the UTC boundary, clearing a date with null, 400 on invalid dates, and the exact UI copy and test ids.
reasons.scope: The diff adds only the due-date field, the overdue filter and the UI changes, plus the spec and plan documents; there is no styling or extra filter value.
reasons.tests: The new tests cover validation, the leap day, patching and clearing, id non-consumption and the overdue boundary with an injected clock, but the page test only greps for static HTML and no test covers the due-date and overdue rendering in the browser.
reasons.conventions: The change uses ValidationError, adds data-testid attributes, uses no dependencies, follows TDD, and matches the existing style.
reasons.architecture: The overdue rule lives only in the store with an injectable clock, the app only maps the query parameter, and the page asks the server instead of duplicating the rule.
reasons.codeQuality: The code is clean and correct, and update validates every field before mutating, but checkDueDate builds a Date from a non-string value before the type check and the page makes two requests per render.
